correctness.rationale: PASS. In the finite one-excitation sector with J>0 and both point-loss rates strictly positive, the dissipative generator B=-iH-Gamma/2 is contractive. Its imaginary-axis eigenspace equals the joint dark subspace of H-eigenvectors vanishing at sites 0 and a, and is reducing; the complement decays. Fourier energies -2J cos((2pi*m+Phi)/N) are degenerate only at Phi=0 or pi modulo 2pi. At exceptional class s in {0,1}, paired indices m and -m-s admit a dark difference exactly when Q=N/gcd(N,a) divides 2m+s; fixed-point indices do not contribute. Counting qualifying two-cycles recovers every parity branch of d_0,d_pi and the roots-of-unity sum gives every site weight S_0(x),S_pi(x), including g=1, Q even, g even, and the flux-switched x=g/2 class. An independent fresh Fourier-pair generator with 56,756 (N,a,s,x) cases through N=44 checked the exact predicted multiplicities and projector diagonals; it is finite corroboration, not the unrestricted proof.
residual_risks: Finite verification cannot prove all N; perturbing flux away from 0/pi alters asymptotic dark space discontinuously; absorber rates must both be positive.
